ukberi-tibyan:2-2.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (وَطُورِ سِينِينَ (٢)).
The words of the Exalted (سِينِينَ): it is a dialectal form of «سَيْنَاءَ», and it has been discussed in al-Muʾminūn.

ukberi-tibyan:4-4.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنْسَانَ فِي أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ (٤)).
The words of the Exalted (فِي أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ): it is in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الْإِنْسَانَ». By «التَّقْوِيم» is meant «الْقَوَام» (upright stature), because «التَّقْوِيم» is an act, and that is a description of the Creator, not of the created. It may also be that the implied form is: «فِي أَحْسَنِ قَوَامِ التَّقْوِيمِ» (in the best stature of shaping), with the muḍāf (first term of the construct) omitted. It may also be that «فِي» is redundant (zāʾida), i.e. «قَوَّمْنَاهُ أَحْسَنَ تَقْوِيمٍ» (We shaped him in the best shaping).

ukberi-tibyan:5-5.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَاهُ أَسْفَلَ سَافِلِينَ (٥)).
The words of the Exalted (أَسْفَلَ): it is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object; it may also be a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted «مَكَان» (place).

ukberi-tibyan:7-7.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِالدِّينِ (٧)).
The words of the Exalted (فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ): «مَا» is an interrogative in the sense of disapproval (inkār), i.e. what is it that drives you, O man, to deny the Resurrection?

ukberi-tibyan:8-8.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ الْحَاكِمِينَ (٨)).
The words of the Exalted (أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ الْحَاكِمِينَ): that is, He is the Most Wise of judges, glory be to Him. And Allah knows best.
